name: The Koop
summary: The Koop is rude and grumpy and very strong. He does mostly punches and jumps rarely. His special attack cooldown is twice as fast as others.

source.parsed_text:
The Koop is rude and grumpy and very strong. He does mostly punches and jumps rarely.  His special attack cooldown is twice as fast as others.

Special moves:
- Throws a server box at you, pulls out a giant server box and throws it at you.
- Crouches and pulls out a laptop to remove all your access to web services causing major momentary confusion of the enemy as they check their cell phone, watch, etc.

inferred_stats.reason: very strong brute who focuses on heavy punches

victory_pose: The Koop crosses his arms and sneers disdainfully at his fallen opponent.

specials.name: Server Box Throw
specials.description: Pulls out a giant server box and throws it at you.
pose_frames: Leaning back pulling a heavy server box over his shoulder
Lunging forward hurling the server box
specials.prop: A massive metallic computer server box with flashing LED lights

specials.name: Access Revocation
specials.description: Crouches and pulls out a laptop to remove all your access to web services causing major momentary confusion.
pose_frames: Crouched down furiously typing on a laptop
Standing up slamming the laptop shut
